title: fix(app-shell): the Studio hook editor grants a sandboxed-JS body its capabilities
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8NXMWsw485tJX2E1nPnfkda)_

Fixes #26726

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 钩子编辑器的「函数」区，在沙箱 JS 函数体下新增「能力授权」勾选列表（api.read / api.write / api.transaction / crypto.uuid / log），选项直接读 spec 的 `HookBodyCapability`，勾选即写 `body.capabilities`。
- 为什么改:调用 `ctx.api` 等的钩子必须声明能力，否则运行时抛错；之前 Studio 没有任何入口能写这个列表，只能走 API 修。这是本卡的 ui 半张，服务端 500 的半张另有子卡。
- 风险与回滚:只改编辑器写出的元数据，沙箱的能力校验原样不动；表达式函数体不显示该控件，切到表达式会去掉授权（表达式体本就拒收该键）。有问题直接 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`HookDefaultInspector.tsx` 里的 `toggleCapability` 与 `setLanguage`，然后 Function 区新增的 `hook-body-capabilities` 块，最后 `HookDefaultInspector.capabilities-26726.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/HookDefaultInspector.capabilities-26726.test.tsx`，预期 9 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地。

## What changes

Base `c4a4aefc`, then `origin/main` `57820085` merged in at `5e04bdcd` (no conflict; it moved rows into the same `studio` i18n namespace but none of the `engine.inspector.hook.*` rows).

- **`HookDefaultInspector.tsx`, Function section.** For a `language: 'js'` body, a "Capabilities" checkbox list, one box per `HookBodyCapability` token read from the spec enum (`HookBodyCapability.options`), each with the `ctx` call it unlocks underneath (`ctx.api.object(…).find / findOne / count / aggregate`, and so on). Ticking writes `body.capabilities` in the spec's token order; unticking the last writes `[]`, the spec default.
- **Expression bodies.** No control is drawn, and no edit of an expression body writes the key. Switching a body's language away from `js` drops `capabilities`, `timeoutMs` and `memoryMb` from the written body (the keys of `ScriptBodySchema.shape` that `ExpressionBodySchema.shape` lacks, read off the spec), because `ExpressionBodySchema` is strict and refuses each by name (its L2-only guidance).
- **A stored token the spec does not list** (a typo, the retired `crypto.hash`) stays on screen as an extra, ticked, flagged box, and is kept on the next write until the author unticks it, so it never disappears unseen; the save's parse still names it.
- **Nothing is inferred from the body's source.**
- **"More fields".** No change needed: `body` was already a curated key as a whole (`CURATED_FIELDS`), which is exactly why nothing reached `body.capabilities`. The docblock claimed the js capabilities fell through to that form; it now says what is true.
- **`ObjectHooksPanel.tsx`.** Unchanged: it merges each patch shallowly and the control's patch is a whole `body`, so the host needs nothing new.
- **i18n.** `engine.inspector.hook.capabilities`, `engine.inspector.hook.capabilitiesHint`, `engine.inspector.hook.capabilityUnknown` in the lazy `studio` namespace, `en` and `zh`. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n`; `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`.

## Why

Triage first grade on the card, verbatim: "**p2, two halves:** the Studio hook editor has no `capabilities` control (ui), and a hook refused for a missing capability answers the client 500, not a named refusal (`domain:server`, a child card filed on claim). ⛔ The capability check stays as strict as it is." This PR is the ui half; the server half is the child card #26903 and is not touched here.

## Tests

`HookDefaultInspector.capabilities-26726.test.tsx`, ten cases. Every draft is the authored hook fed through `HookSchema.parse`, and every written body is parsed back through `HookSchema`:

- one box per spec token, in enum order, read off `HookBodyCapability.options`, with the `ctx` call hint;
- picking `api.read` writes `body.capabilities: ['api.read']` and the saved hook parses;
- an existing grant renders ticked, and a new grant is written in spec order beside it, `source` untouched;
- clearing the last grant writes `[]`, which parses to the same body as no grant;
- an expression body shows no control, and its source edit writes no `capabilities`;
- switching a granted js body to an expression drops the grant and the saved hook parses;
- switching a js body with limits (`timeoutMs`, `memoryMb`) to an expression drops every L2-only key and the saved hook parses;
- an unlisted stored token stays visible, flagged and kept, and unticking it removes it;
- "More fields", fed a server schema that carries `body.capabilities`, draws no second control for it (positive control: it does draw the uncurated `timeout`);
- the label and hint read in the designer locale (zh catalogue preloaded with `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`).

<details><summary>Runs</summary>

- New file: 9/9 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0), on `cef362e9` and again on `5e04bdcd`.
- Neighbours: every `HookDefaultInspector.*.test.tsx`, `inspectorStrings.hookAction.i18n-10586`, every `ObjectHooksPanel*.test.tsx`, plus `packages/i18n/`: 101 files, 1432 passed / 13 skipped, exit 0, on `cef362e9` and again on `5e04bdcd`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check`: exit 0 on both heads (`tsconfig.test.json` compiles the new test).
- `eslint` on the two touched app-shell files: 0 errors (one pre-existing `react-refresh/only-export-components` warning on `HookTargetScopeContext`).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-shot, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; each leg restored to the HEAD blob with an empty git diff HEAD)</summary>

- Leg A, drop the write (`patchBody({ capabilities: … })` replaced by a no-op): 4 of 9 red, exactly the pick, round-trip, clear and unlisted-token cases.
- Leg B, keep the grant across a language switch (the `delete next.capabilities` line removed): 1 of 9 red, the language-switch case.
- Leg C (patch round 1, head `c042e7be`), the L2-only delete loop removed: 2 of 10 red, both switch cases; restored.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The options are read from the spec at runtime (`import { HookBodyCapability } from '@objectstack/spec/data'`), not copied. The inspector already imports runtime values from that same entry through `ConditionBuilder`, and it loads behind the deferred designer loader (`pageRouteLoadsNoStudioChunks-12187.test.tsx`), so the read adds nothing to the console's eager closure; `Build & E2E UI` weighs that closure in CI.
- Not changed, noted: `body.timeoutMs` and `body.memoryMb` still have no Studio control of their own (the language switch now drops them, patch round 1). Read from the code, not measured; left for a follow-up if wanted.
- The sandbox's capability check and the server's refusal mapping are untouched (#26903 carries the server half).

## Verification

Patch round 1 at `c042e7be`: the same 34 families, all exit 0 (`--ran` 34/34); `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` timed out two cases under shared-box load on the first pass, then exit 0 alone and on a full re-run. Gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `5e04bdcd` (the same 34 families as on `cef362e9`): 34 run, all exit 0, reconciled by `--ran` (34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN). Every family CI runs is read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run locally.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [ ] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (No formatter ran; the repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's run, read from `Lint UI` / `Lint & Repo Gates`.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
